title: Austin Housing: Senior Homes & New Leaders
summary:
*   The Austin Housing Finance Corporation appointed new leadership, including Mayor Kirk Watson as its President.
*   City-owned land was approved for transfer, free of charge, to build affordable housing for seniors near Tillery and Oak Springs as part of the City's SMART Housing Program.

BOARD OF DIRECTOR'S MEETING
AUSTIN HOUSING FINANCE CORPORATION
MINUTES
THURSDAY, JUNE 22,2000
The Board meeting of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) was convened at 3:53
p.m. The following agenda items (set forth on the City of Austin Council Meeting agenda as
items 76-77) were the AHFC items considered by the Austin Housing Finance Corporation's
Board of Directors.
1. 
Approve a resolution to elect Mayor Kirk Watson as President, and appoint Jesus Garza as
General Manager, Andrew Martin as General Counsel, and Shirley A. Brown as assistant
secretary of the corporation. (000622-76)
Resolution No. 2000-0622-01 was approved on Board Member Slusher's motion, Vice
President Goodman's second by a 7-0.
2. 
Approve a resolution accepting the transfer of City-owned land located near Tillery and Oak
Springs pursuant to section 272.001(g), Texas Local Government Code, without monetary
consideration for the development of low-income or moderate-income housing for the elderly
under the City's SMART Housing Program. (Council Member Daryl Slusher, Mayor Pro Tern
Jackie Goodman and Mayor Kirk Watson) (000622-77)
Resolution No. 2000-0622-02 was approved on Board Member Slusher's motion, Vice
President Goodman's second by a 7-0 vote.
The motion to adjourn the meeting at 3:55 p.m. was approved on Board Member Slusher's
motion, Board Member Thomas' second by a 7-0 vote.
